title: New York-based Ease Health, which is building an AI-native OS for behavioral health providers, emerged from stealth and raised a $41M Series A led by a16z (Vignesh R/Tech Funding News)
summary: Vignesh R / Tech Funding News: New York-based Ease Health, which is building an AI-native OS for behavioral health providers, emerged from stealth and raised a $41M Series A led by a16z — Behavioural health providers across the US are struggling with outdated software. Most clinics use separate systems for admissions, patient records, and billing.
